findings.claim: The declared objective is final predicted target affinity primary, with validity and strain secondary and coordinate control only; the reward view is the endpoint pointcloud with a detached Hungarian endpoint mean-squared-distance and native endpoint VJP, so no affinity-head derivative or extra model forward is available as evidence.

The observed learning window is the score-time grid 0.0 to 0.49 in native model endpoint world coordinates, with recorded affinities removed and an equal score prior; curve support is reported only over [0.0,0.49], so no outcome or terminal-label evidence exists inside the supplied support.

Continuous contrast functions over the complete observed support are non-monotone: landmark_00_soft_mass shows four sign changes with a positive early rate and a negative late rate, and landmark_00_local_dx shows six sign changes with nine strong sign conflicts, so a constant rule is not supported and any time-conditioned rule would need validated fits rather than arbitrary bins.

Several landmark local contrast features have large early-versus-late rate reversals (for example landmark_00_local_dy and landmark_00_local_cyy), but their relative node RMSE is large and polynomial fits are not accepted, so these are descriptive rate changes rather than validated absolute reward targets.

Landmark local curvature and cross terms (landmark_00_local_cxx, landmark_00_local_dz) also show sign changes and strong sign conflicts with unaccepted polynomial fits, indicating that isolated marginal descriptors are unstable and coherent joint patterns would be needed before any coupling claim.

hypotheses.direction: time-conditioned rather than constant coordinate contrast
hypotheses.falsifier: no sign reversal in the soft-mass contrast on held-out observed nodes, or a constant rule matching the time-conditioned rule within node RMSE
hypotheses.observable: landmark_00_soft_mass contrast over observed score nodes
hypotheses.statement: A time-conditioned regional attention recipe that follows the validated sign of the landmark soft-mass contrast over the observed window would express the observed early-positive/late-negative rate reversal better than a constant static regional rule.

hypotheses.direction: joint pattern rather than isolated marginal descriptor
hypotheses.falsifier: a single local contrast with accepted fit and no strong sign conflicts predicting the same direction as the joint pattern
hypotheses.observable: landmark local dx/dy/cyy contrasts and their sign-conflict counts
hypotheses.statement: Isolated landmark local displacement contrasts are not a sufficient basis for a coordinate intervention because their rate reversals coincide with large node RMSE and many strong sign conflicts; a joint or mode-level pattern would be required instead.

limitations: No decoded terminal labels or current-study outcome data are supplied, so last-record or survival credit cannot be presented as final affinity benefit.

No survival, increment, turnover, joint-diagnostic or branch-adjusted tables were read in this turn, so selection enrichment versus absolute geometric descriptors and cohort-composition versus within-path change remain unassessed.
The supplied evidence is diagnostic coordinate contrast data; it is not physical interaction energy and does not establish neural-module causation.
Temperatures are immutable fixed parameters and no temperature edit is proposed or evaluated.
